title: Medical Mattress Care: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned 'The made bed'. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. The press-into-the-foam 3D hero is already pinned and lives in every option.

options.label: The made bed
options.lineage: the ward bed seen from above: tucked hospital corners, folded sheets, the 200 x 90 plan
options.thesis: The site is a bed being made and unmade: sheet, cover, foam, each layer folded back to show what it does.
materials: visco foam that remembers your press
options.viewport: Top-down indigo mattress at true 200:90 proportion fills the screen; cursor presses in, orange pressure bloom, slow visco recovery. Headline sits on the sheet fold, quote button pinned top right.
options.risk: If the fold transitions are timid, it reads as a plain dark hero with a 3D gimmick.

raised.raise: 210 PU cover specs become six calm instrument readouts (95 °C, 115 °C, CRIB 5, 200 cm water column, 600 g vapour, MRSA) with damped needles, not bullet points.
Layer stack text is banded: each line of copy sits in the course of the foam layer it describes, its height matching the layer's cm.
Every press leaves a visible, slowly fading imprint: the material's memory is the feedback state across the site, not just the hero.
Full commitment to flat colour fields: indigo owns whole sections edge to edge, one idea per field.
Custom-work process is a numbered fold sequence in a strict margin column; each step keeps the earlier creases.

options.label: Pressure map
options.lineage: clinical pressure-mapping mats: heat-map grids over a body outline, as OTs read them
options.thesis: Every product is shown as the pressure it takes away: the heat map is the brand.
options.viewport: A body-outline pressure grid full screen; your cursor is the load, cells go orange to indigo as the MMC Flex redistributes.
options.risk: Familiar data-viz look and colder than the client's 'warm 9/10' ask.

options.label: Night instrument panel
options.thesis: MMC as a calm instrument panel: six gauges that all agree your patient is safe.
options.viewport: Six spec gauges around the 3D mattress, needles settle as the cover proves itself.
options.case: Strong on product clarity for specs; loses on warmth and audience identification.
options.risk: Reads cold and technical, opposite of the family-business brief.

options.label: Cut-paper title sequence
options.thesis: The MMC story told in timed flat-colour cards.
options.viewport: Orange field, a black cut-paper mattress silhouette.
options.case: Buyers want specs fast; timed cards slow them down.
options.kept: Total commitment to flat colour fields, one idea per field.

options.label: Floated pigment
options.thesis: Pressure as pigment displaced on liquid.
options.case: Beautiful, but buyers do not recognise it and it says nothing about hygiene.
options.kept: Every press leaves a visible imprint that fades: material memory as state.

options.label: Coiled earth tower
options.case: Wrong material world; earthy tones fight hygiene.
options.kept: Text banded in courses matching each layer's thickness.

options.label: Origami crane sequence
options.thesis: One sheet folded step by step.
options.viewport: A red square folding into a crane.
options.case: Folding overlaps the made-bed world, which owns it more truthfully.
options.kept: Numbered fold steps in a margin column, each step keeps earlier creases.

options.label: Hybrid bitmap collage
options.viewport: Angled type ramps over pixelated stills.
options.case: Loud and disorienting for buyers who want a spec table.
options.kept: Courage in scale jumps: footnote to billboard in one view.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean care-supplier site, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, product photo right, category tiles below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Duvatex and Sampli by design.
